description: Refactor a complex function or method to resolve a Sonar-style cyclomatic complexity issue without changing behavior.
requirements: Repository should identify the original complex function or method in code, README.md or commit message
Refactor should reduce nested conditionals, repeated branches or oversized decision logic
Behavior should remain compatible with the original feature
Automated tests should cover the refactored logic
No new lint, type-check or test failures should be introduced
Commit message or README.md should summarize the refactoring approach
title: Fix Sonar Cyclomatic Complexity Issue
